title: Python’s Type System
description: Use Python’s optional static type system as a design tool while staying honest about runtime behavior.
learningOutcomes: Distinguish runtime validation from static analysis
Model nullable, generic, structural, and mapping-shaped data precisely
Choose among TypedDict, dataclass, and Pydantic models
Configure mypy and pyright for useful strictness

lessons.title: Runtime and Static Typing
lessons.description: Annotations, Any, object, None, unions, narrowing, and the boundary of the checker.

lessons.title: Collections, Callables, and Type Aliases
lessons.description: Type modern Python collections and function boundaries without noisy annotations.

lessons.title: Generics, Protocols, and Variance
lessons.description: Design repository contracts with TypeVar, bounds, structural typing, and practical variance.
learningObjectives: Reason about variance at API boundaries

lessons.title: TypedDict, Dataclass, and Pydantic
lessons.description: Choose the right data-modeling tool for internal state, external payloads, and typed mappings.
learningObjectives: Explain when runtime validation is required

lessons.title: Advanced Typing and Type Checkers
lessons.description: Use Literal, Final, ClassVar, overload, generic protocols, mypy, and pyright pragmatically.

assignment.title: Assignment: Typed Repository and Service Boundary
assignment.description: Refactor the in-memory project around typed entities, repository protocols, and a service layer.
learningObjectives: Validate the design with a type checker
